text.description_html:
Omnia 907.07, Traditional Solid Brass Replacement Lever Pair

Simple in design, this door lever pair will not disappoint those looking for an elegant way to improve the style of any home. The Classic Solid Brass Lever is packaged as a pair (2 levers) only. It does not include rosettes or a latch.

Features and Specifications of the 904 Replacement Pair of Omnia 904 Levers:

  • Lever Length: 4-3/4"
  • Lever Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Solid Brass Construction

Special orded item. No Returns
